source.title: Changes in the WCA Board of Directors (July 2023)
source.content:
With the term of Board Member Ethan Pride coming to an end, an anonymous election took place on July 1st, 2023. The election was conducted according to the [WCA Motion: Election of Directors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2021.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf).

The Board received the applications of:

- Ethan Pride 
- Kerrie Jarman
- Michael Chai

<!-- break -->

We are happy to announce that the election was successful and that **Ethan Pride** was re-elected and both **Kerrie Jarman** and **Michael Chai**  were newly elected members of the WCA Board of Directors.

These changes have become effective immediately.

Ethan, Kerrie and Michael's applications can be viewed [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1b01arL_-POHBCx4glSDgGiS7305_XMsQ?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 董事会成员变动（2023 年 7 月）
translation.content:
Ethan Pride 的董事任期即将结束，因此 WCA 于 2023 年 7 月 1 日举行了不记名选举。选举依照《[WCA 决议：董事选举](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2021.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf)》进行。

董事会收到以下人员的申请：

- Ethan Pride
- Kerrie Jarman
- Michael Chai

<!-- break -->

我们很高兴宣布，选举顺利完成。**Ethan Pride** 连任，**Kerrie Jarman** 和 **Michael Chai** 新当选为 WCA 董事。

以上任命立即生效。

Ethan、Kerrie 和 Michael 的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1b01arL_-POHBCx4glSDgGiS7305_XMsQ?usp=sharing)查看。
